title: CartControllerContract
description: Owns the list of cart line items. Exposes two actions: setItems for bulk replacement of the entire cart, and updateItemQuantity for adjusting the quantity of a single existing line item.

CartState.title: CartState
CartState.description: The current contents of the cart. Owned exclusively by the backend; the frontend must not mutate this directly.
CartState.$comment: This schema validates the runtime state value the backend pushes to the frontend.

items.description: The current line items in the cart.

SetItemsAction.title: setItems
SetItemsAction.description: Replaces the entire cart contents with the provided list of items.

items.description: The new complete list of cart items. An empty array clears the cart.

UpdateItemQuantityAction.title: updateItemQuantity
UpdateItemQuantityAction.description: Updates the quantity of a single existing cart line item identified by productId.
